title: Theory that shooter Valente was awaiting programmed instruction

tellings.quote: Or maybe he was awaiting instruction, subliminal or conscious instruction.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, discusses a shooter named Valente, in a December 2025 story that touches Boston, Providence and Brooklyn. Michels suggests that Valente may have been waiting for instructions, given to him either openly or subliminally. If true, it would mean someone else was directing him.
